## Load DB tables and RSA

```{r}
Scenarios.IDs <- read.csv(paste0(MPath, "inputs/Scenarios_ID.csv"))
RSA.IDs <- read.csv(paste0(MPath, "inputs/RSA_ID.csv"))
# RSHA.IDs <- read.csv("CRB-MARSHAL/inputs/RSHA_ID.csv")

RSA_list <- RSA.IDs$RSA_id[1] # Implement a way to select RSA_ids

# LOAD RSA FILES AND CREATE A META FILE
RSA.all      <- tibble()
for(RSA_id in RSA_list){
  RSAi <- read.csv(paste0(MPath, "inputs/RSA/", RSA_id, ".csv"))
  RSAi$RSA_id <- RSA_id
  RSA.all <- rbind(RSA.all, RSAi)
}
```

## Define scenario

kr_reg and kx_reg function (TO DEVELOP)

```{r}
kr_reg <- function(x, timing){
  if(x <= timing[1]){
    kr <- 1.8e-4
  }else if(x > timing[1] & x <= timing[2]){
    kr <- 1.8e-5
  }else if(x > timing[2]){
    kr <- 1.8e-6
  }
  return(kr)
}

kx_reg <- function(x, timing){
  if(x <= timing[1]){
    kx <- 3.0e-2
  }else if(x > timing[1] & x <= timing[2]){
    kx <- 0.1
  }else if(x > timing[2]){
    kx <- 4
  }
  return(kx)
}
```


```{r}
Scenario_id  <- "no_sub"

# Generate conds filte
conds.test <- create.conds(xmax = 40, timing1 = 7, timing2 = 20, SG = T)
conds.test$y[conds.test$type == "kr" & conds.test$x >= 7] <- 1.8e-5
```

## Load pre-computed scenarios

```{r}
Conds_1A <- read.csv("./Data/conds_scenarios/1A.csv")
Conds_1B <- read.csv("./Data/conds_scenarios/1B.csv")
Conds_2 <- read.csv("./Data/conds_scenarios/2.csv")
Conds_3 <- read.csv("./Data/conds_scenarios/3.csv")
```

Convert 

```{r}
order_id = c(1,2,3)
order = c("Taproot", "Lateral", "LongLateral")

orders_df <- tibble(order_id, order)

Conds.conv <- Conds_1A[c("x", "kr", "Kx")] 
colnames(Conds.conv) <- c("x", "kr", "kx")
Conds.conv <- Conds.conv %>% 
  gather(kr, kx, key = "type", value = "y")

Conds.conv <- merge(Conds.conv, orders_df)
Conds.conv$id <- seq(1, nrow(Conds.conv))
Conds.conv <- Conds.conv[c("order_id", "order", "x", "type", "y", "id")]

# Add a zero x
Conds.conv <- rbind(Conds.conv, 
                    Conds.conv %>% filter(x == 1) %>% mutate(x = 0))
```


## Loop MARSHAL

```{r, include = F}
conds <- Conds.conv
path.out <- paste0(MPath, "outputs/", Scenario_id, "/")

# Create folder for the Scenario
if(dir.exists(path.out)){
  unlink(paste0(path.out, "*"), recursive = F)
}else{
  dir.create(path.out)
}

# MARSHAL PARAMETERS
# conds        <- read.csv("CRB-MARSHAL/inputs/conductivities3.csv")
soil         <- read.csv(paste0(MPath, "inputs/soil.csv"))

# ============================================================================ #
results <- run.MARSHAL.loop(RSA_list, RSA.all, 
                            Scenario_id = Scenario_id, 
                            conds, soil, 
                            tmin = 1, tmax = 30, step = 0.5,       # Decomposition of RSA timing 
                            timing1 = 7, timing2 = 20)           # SG timing
# ============================================================================ #

RSHA.all <- results$RSHA.all
Macro.all <- results$Macro.all

write.csv(RSHA.all, paste0(path.out, "RSHA_all.csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(Macro.all, paste0(path.out, "Macro_all.csv"), row.names = F)
```

Make plots

```{r}
Scenario_id <- "Scenario_1A"
path.out <- paste0(MPath, "outputs/", Scenario_id, "/")

RSHA.all <- read.csv(paste0(path.out, "RSHA_all.csv"))
Macro.all <- read.csv(paste0(path.out, "Macro_all.csv"))

plot.path <- paste0(path.out, "plots/")


# Create folder for the Scenario
if(dir.exists(plot.path)){
  unlink(paste0(plot.path, "*"), recursive = F)
}else{
  dir.create(plot.path)
}

unlink(paste0(plot.path, "*"), recursive = F)

for(ti in unique(RSHA.all$age)){
  cat("ti : ", ti, "\n")
  plot.CRBM(RSHA.all, Macro.all, ti, path.plot = plot.path, Krs.max = 0.1)
}
```

```{r}
library(magick)
img <- list.files(plot.path, pattern = ".png")
img_list <- lapply(paste0(plot.path, img), image_read)
img_join <- image_join(img_list)
img_animated <- image_animate(img_join, delay = 10)
  
image_write(image = img_animated,
            path = paste0(path.out, "animated.gif"))
```
